newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks seen following through on gains.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks seen following through on gains.

text.p: Argentine stocks were expected to carry on rising at the opening Monday, encouraged by strength in the U.S. markets, dealers said.

"The market will continue to be favored by the good mood in New York after last week's payrolls data, which have knocked U.S. long bond yields down to a three-year low," said Norman Trabucco at Zaracan traders.
The blue-chip MerVal index rallied 3.5 percent last week, setting two consecutive new five-year highs and closing Friday at 837.95.

"The momentum of the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision not to touch interest rates and of Thursday's excellent jobs report may last several more days and the MerVal will probably aim for new lofty levels," another dealer said.
He said the market would aim for near-term resistance at 850, provided foreign cash flows stay strong.
Traders also said expectations of a foreign debt buyback scheme in the second half of the year would continue to underpin the market and help offset jitters ahead of October mid-term elections.
